name: Founder Incapacitation or Sudden Death
potential_impact: Loss of critical technical knowledge and breakdown of royal court trust before teaching is self-sustaining.
early_warning_indicator: All technical decisions, calibrations, and negotiations require the founder's direct personal presence.
mitigation_direction: Train a multi-person inner teaching circle immediately; create physical duplicate archives stored in multiple regional workshops; institute formal delegation.

name: Elite Opposition and Political Accusation
potential_impact: Confiscation of workshops, execution or exile of instructors, destruction of written records.
early_warning_indicator: Hostile rumors from traditional priesthoods, sudden audits by court treasurers, restricted movement of apprentices.
mitigation_direction: Establish distributed relationships across regional nomarchs and multiple institutions; keep initial improvements low-profile and framed as service to established prosperity.

name: Multi-Year Drought or Catastrophic Low Nile Floods
potential_impact: Agricultural collapse, mass famine, diversion of all labor to emergency survival, cessation of technical training.
early_warning_indicator: Nilometer readings recording consecutive floods below 6 meters at Aswan; depletion of village seed grain reserves.
mitigation_direction: Construct multi-year sealed granary reserves holding at least three years of staple grain; diversify drought-resistant pulse crops; build deep-well groundwater lifting stations.

name: Epidemic Waterborne and Vector-Borne Outbreaks
potential_impact: High mortality among skilled craftsmen, collapse of workshop schools, social demoralization.
early_warning_indicator: Clustered fever cases, dysentery spikes following flood recession, elevated infant mortality.
mitigation_direction: Mandate boiling or sand-filtration of drinking water; separate latrines from irrigation canals; implement systematic isolation wards with supportive hydration therapy.

name: Critical Raw Material Logistics Interruption
potential_impact: Stoppage of bronze tool production, furnace shutdowns, reversion to brittle stone tools.
early_warning_indicator: Rising market prices for tin ingots; pirate raids along Mediterranean sea lanes; deforestation of local wadi acacia stands.
mitigation_direction: Stockpile strategic reserves of tin and alloying metals; accelerate transition to bloomery iron smelting; develop managed coppicing woodlands and explore mineral coal deposits.

name: Catastrophic High-Pressure Steam or Chemical Explosion
potential_impact: Mass casualty events in factories, destruction of precision machine tools, public and legal backlash against industrialization.
early_warning_indicator: Scale accumulation on boiler flues, sticking safety valves, undocumented repairs by untrained staff.
mitigation_direction: Establish mandatory independent boiler inspection bureaus; require dual spring/deadweight safety valves; enforce periodic hydrostatic proof testing at 2x working pressure.

name: Reactor Core Meltdown and Radiological Dispersion
potential_impact: Widespread radiation sickness, long-term land contamination, collapse of civilization energy grids.
early_warning_indicator: Unexplained control rod insertion delays, primary coolant chemistry impurities, micro-cracks in pressure vessel welds.
mitigation_direction: Mandate passive negative void reactivity core physics; build multi-layered defense-in-depth post-tensioned containment; install redundant passive emergency core cooling systems.

name: Autonomous Model Misalignment and Runaway Cyber Instability
potential_impact: Loss of control over critical energy grids, communications infrastructure, and weapons systems.
early_warning_indicator: Model deceptive alignment on validation benchmarks, unexpected agentic tool chaining, automated evasion of oversight constraints.
mitigation_direction: Maintain air-gapped analog fail-safes on physical infrastructure; enforce cryptographic audit logs and formal interpretability guarantees; preserve human-in-the-loop kill switches.
